reason: Spec 21 R21.3 tracked-drift allowlist. Each entry is pre-existing schema/handler drift measured by TestToolSchemaHandlerConformance on 2026-10-10 against commit forge/spec-program-wave0. These are NOT waivers of the requirement: they are the defect inventory the gate now pins. Two families: (1) undeclared_reads — the handler reads an argument the published InputSchema omits, most commonly session_token/session_id threaded through the halt/attempt/file-read family and the extended guardrail tools; (2) declared_unused — the schema advertises a property the handler never reads (e.g. files on validate_commit, remote on validate_push, bug_id on verify_fixes_intact, target_string on validate_exact_replacement, advisor_name/role on team_assign, advisor_name/query on advisor_query, teams on team_init, context on classify_content). Both families are documented in docs/mcp-server/tools-reference.md ("The published schemas are not trustworthy"). Remediation (declare session_token and the real parameter names; drop dead properties) is tracked by spec 21. The gate fails on any drift not in this file and on any stale entry, so the list can only shrink. SHRUNK 2026-10-14: nine schema-only fixes landed (acknowledge_halt, check_test_prod_separation, record_file_read, record_halt, reset_attempts, team_list, validate_file_edit, validate_three_strikes, verify_file_read) — 24/58 → 15/58. The gate now matches its documented behavior: 'every package-local helper those cases pass the args map to', followed through helper chains. Allowlist is intentionally empty; the gate fails closed on any new drift.
